notes.title: Announcement: Ver.2.0 Release Notice
notes.notes:
Let’s play Shogi (Japanese chess)! 
You can play computer.
[Basic rules]
- Win by taking the opponent’s king. 
- Pieces are promoted when they enter the opponent’s territory (lines 1-3). 
- Captured pieces can be placed as one’s own pieces.

notes.title: Announcement: Ver.1.1 Release Notice
notes.notes:
We would like to announce the release of patch Ver.1.1 for fixes features improvements.

Fixes and Updates:
  * Reduced the necessary storage size.

Features and improvements:
  * "Battle royal of Reversi" - Added a feature to allow select the CPU's strength. CPU response speed up.
  * "Looking for mistakes" - Improved picture.
